tool_signatures.name: assess_service_grant
tool_signatures.description: Use when considering a narrower service grant that must preserve one required service request. Assesses whether after is a supported subset of before and still matches required_type and required_name. For an ordered request list, use assess_service_grant_change when available. Domain-invalid facts return INVALID_INPUT; malformed arguments return a tool error with no decision. Supplied facts are not authenticated; no grant or API operation is applied.

tool_signatures.name: assess_service_grant_change
tool_signatures.description: Use when one proposed service-grant narrowing must preserve an ordered list of required service requests, including duplicates. For one request with flat required_type/required_name fields, use assess_service_grant. Domain-invalid facts and request-limit excess return INVALID_INPUT decisions; malformed arguments return a tool error with no decision. Supplied facts are not authenticated; no grant or service operation is applied.

tool_signatures.name: gooo_compare_alias_origin
tool_signatures.description: Use before a tool-catalog update when an agent-selected exposed name may point to a different server or original function. Supply one target_alias and exact before/after rows with server, original_name and exposed_name. Returns UNCHANGED, ORIGIN_CHANGED, ADDED, REMOVED, ABSENT, AMBIGUOUS or INVALID_INPUT; inspect the original zero-based indexes. Any duplicate exposed name anywhere in either catalog is AMBIGUOUS. Empty domain text returns INVALID_INPUT; malformed JSON or transport limits return a tool error without a report. Preserve supplied spelling and order. These are supplied snapshots, not proof of live server identity, SDK routing, completeness or authority. No tool is invoked and execution_authorized is always false.
